issue.body:
How much validation coverage is lost through test recognition, command selection and output parsing? Follow-up to #28; investigation remains open.

**Live targeting result:** a general selector excluding deleted test paths removes Matchms PR958's missing-file error, but both stages then stop during collection because historical code imports missing `chemap`. No task is recovered. PR671 preserves exact native sets under both selections: 1 fail-to-pass and 30 pass-to-pass tests. Transport, validator/parser, source/test patches and reconstructed image were held fixed; no dependency repair was applied.

**Other findings:** four of six predeclared SAMtools PRs add net Perl test invocations, while the pinned recognizer counts zero for all six. SAMtools also needs a composite runner contract: custom Perl output repeats headings, distinguishes xfail/xpass, and runs alongside C/shell tests; recognition alone is insufficient. SGR normalization passes 12 fixtures in both native and exported parsers. The original outer-only completion candidate is insufficient: actual shell execution can hide inner test failures behind outer exit 0. MNE's explicit broad target remains a separate selection issue. An eight-case pinned-selector audit also exposes option-value confusion and paths appended to shell suffixes; a default-off targeting policy passes 26 selection checks plus complete-package configuration/writer and controlled native/export routing checks. Biological validation remains outstanding.

**Completion candidate:** a separate pytest-specific gate preserves inner exits, fails on native setup errors and prevents exported reward from interrupted runs. Six real pytest/Bash/Git fixture cases and five standalone-export checks pass: expected nop/oracle remain 0/1; partial error credit changes 0.5→0. This is synthetic-repository evidence, not biological recovery. [Checks and limitations](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/ae0ef75b/experiments/32-runner-coverage/pytest-completion-protocol.md).

**Frozen MNE case:** PR14445 is bound to the original retained patches and byte-identical regenerated stage scripts; both stages timed out at 600 seconds. All 12 original bootstrap actions contain leaked `Assistant:` tails and exit 127, so faithful environment reconstruction remains a separate prerequisite. The replay matched all 12 recorded exits, then the unchanged full-suite smoke check timed out at 300 seconds. No image commit or PR14445 validation followed; archive and full cleanup are verified. A separate timing comparison is now submitted with only the exact smoke/fresh limits raised to 1,200 seconds. Its outcome is pending. No command repairs or original-log regrading. [Timing protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4b3bc656/experiments/32-runner-coverage/mne-longcheck-protocol.md).

**Remaining:** collect the MNE timing comparison, evaluate general runner support and MNE targeting, then exercise the revised parser/completion candidate on frozen live cases. Any recovery claim requires complete positive controls. No per-PR command/dependency edits or additional LLM repair loop.

**Execution:** the two prior remote jobs are terminal, totaling 0.72125 allocated CPU-hours; the submitted MNE comparison reserves at most 5 more under the 10-hour ceiling. Prior archives and owned-resource cleanup are verified; the new result and cleanup remain pending. No image was retained from the prior replay. Zero model calls or new capacity. Raw Matchms evidence stays private; reconstruction drift limits historical equivalence. No exports or independent Harbor controls were generated by this comparison.

[Live diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/40a80ef0/experiments/32-runner-coverage/target-live-diagnosis.json) · [Archive/cleanup verification](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/40a80ef0/experiments/32-runner-coverage/live-readback.json) · [Selection checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/40a80ef0/experiments/32-runner-coverage/deleted-target-results.json) · [Full scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/40a80ef0/experiments/32-runner-coverage/issue-scope.md). Detailed logs remain in comments.

Only the exact upstream smoke and fresh-image invocations get 1,200 rather than 300 seconds. The original timeout record remains preserved; all 12 recorded `Assistant:` tails and exit-127 results remain unchanged. Seven pure routing checks passed.

The one-attempt job allows 3,900 seconds work plus 600 for cleanup, at most 5 allocated CPU-hours. Combined with 0.72125 measured from prior #32 jobs, this stays under the existing 10-hour ceiling. No new capacity or model calls. A passing post-check would establish a usable reconstructed image, not PR14445 validation or task recovery. Results, archive readback and cleanup are pending.

[Protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4b3bc656/experiments/32-runner-coverage/mne-longcheck-protocol.md).
